description: Get a JSON catalog download URL and current coverage. One pooled metadata read; the download is a separate request with your API key. The full snapshot stays out of model context.

include_skin_tones.description: Include skin-tone variants. Explicit false excludes them.

lang.description: Optional display language, such as fr or zh-Hant. IDs, numeric values and input parsing stay unchanged.

max_version.description: Latest Emoji release to include, such as 16.0.

profile.description: JSON download profile. Compact retains offline lookup, search and parse facts while omitting bulky artwork details.

version.description: Exact Emoji release version, such as 17.0.

name: emoji_catalog
title: Emoji Catalog
